curated.tagline: Battery model + power profiles on the Omarchy bar
curated.description: Omarchy power plugin: battery percentage, charge state, and profile switching in the bar, backed by a small helper that reads /proc power data. Reworked battery model with consumer/history test coverage.
highlights: Bar battery state with profile switching
Helper reads /proc directly — no heavyweight deps
Listed on the official Omarchy plugin marketplace
curated.architecture: sysfs/power_supply reader → percent/state model → bar widget + panel

github.description: Omarchy bar widget for laptop power: battery state, an ASCII charge-history graph, top resource consumers and power-profile switching.
